compress_and_save_dataset: compress a video dataset into a pickled binary file for the TouchGo Gelsight dataset
read_video_ffmpeg: read a video file using ffmpeg and return frames as a numpy array
numpy_to_binary: convert a numpy array image to a binary JPEG buffer using OpenCV
check_saved_dataset: load and display frames from a saved pickled TouchGo dataset file
main: process all objects in the TouchGo dataset directory and compress each into a pickle file
